name: 男童徽章双色polo衫款
description: 晴空蓝黄童趣天空风，双色翻领polo，徽章与螺纹细节，户外场景收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF packshots, sky blue #AEDCF0 campaign panels, warm cream #FDF6EC outdoor scenes, pale sky-blue matte board #E8F4FB detail boards
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight-style studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte white board and smooth sky-blue paper backdrop
styleLock.typography: rounded friendly geometric sans-serif with bold brush-style headline accents in deep-sea blue #2E5E8C
styleLock.iconSystem: flat doodle icons (clouds, paper plane, gift box) in a single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the garment, consistent scale across colorways and scenes
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent playful kids summer fashion visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud white #FFFFFF, sky blue #AEDCF0, sunny yellow #F5C542 and deep-sea blue text #2E5E8C; bright soft daylight-style lighting with a front-left key and gentle contact shadows; rounded friendly geometric sans-serif with bold brush-style headline accents; flat doodle icons in one accent color; clean garment photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的童装白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view, garment on an invisible ghost-mannequin form, full silhouette visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front key with soft fill, soft contact shadow
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the garment fills the frame to platform standard
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}, a short-sleeve polo shirt. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The shirt presented on an invisible ghost-mannequin form, straight-on eye-level view, collar and placket facing the camera, full silhouette visible with nothing clipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the garment. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame, with no extra whitespace so it meets marketplace main-image density. 8K commercial kids-wear quality. Negative: no child model, no hanger hooks or hard shadows, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no cut-off sleeves or edges.

shots.intent: 用晴空涂鸦氛围一秒传达夏日童趣穿着主张
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, garment on the left third of the frame
shots.lighting: bright soft daylight-style light, soft front-left key, gentle contact shadow
shots.background: sky blue #AEDCF0 with flat cloud cutouts #FFFFFF
shots.props: flat white cloud cutouts #FFFFFF and one small paper-plane doodle, never covering the garment
shots.whitespace: generous negative space across the right 40% reserved for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The shirt shown at a slight 3/4 angle on the left third, occupying 50-60% of the frame. Background sky blue #AEDCF0 with flat white cloud cutouts #FFFFFF and one small paper-plane doodle, props never covering the garment. Bright soft daylight-style lighting with a soft front-left key and a gentle contact shadow. Generous negative space across the right 40% reserved for copy. Negative: no dense body text, no invented fabric percentages or claims, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no props overlapping the garment.

shots.intent: 并排展示两个配色，让买家按喜好选择
shots.camera: both colorways at the same slight 3/4 angle, side by side with identical crop
shots.lighting: even soft studio lighting, identical on both colorways, soft contact shadows
shots.whitespace: slim even margin around both garments, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid for {product} in two colorways side by side, the blue colorway #AEDCF0 tone family and the yellow colorway #F5C542 tone family, each presented on its own low white riser. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Both colorways shot at the same slight 3/4 angle with identical even soft studio lighting and consistent scale. Background pure white #FFFFFF. The pair occupies 70-80% of the frame overall with a slim even margin around both garments and no extra whitespace. Negative: no lighting drift between colorways, no invented size charts or numbers, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no extra props.

shots.intent: 让家长代入孩子夏日户外玩耍的真实穿着场景
shots.camera: photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, child seen only from the back
shots.lighting: warm late-afternoon sunlight from the upper left, 5200K, soft long shadows
shots.background: sunlit playground with soft-focus green foliage and a warm cream path #FDF6EC
shots.props: blurred playground slide in the background and one small ball at the frame edge, not covering the garment
shots.whitespace: moderate breathing room above the child, no extra whitespace elsewhere
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product} worn by a generic child model shown only from the back, photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle so no face is visible. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The child reaches toward blurred playground equipment, the garment sharply in focus and occupying 40-50% of the frame. Warm late-afternoon sunlight from the upper left, 5200K, soft long shadows on a warm cream path #FDF6EC, soft-focus green foliage and a blurred slide in the background, one small ball at the frame edge not covering the garment. Moderate breathing room above the child, no extra whitespace elsewhere. Negative: no recognizable child face, no frontal view of the model, no hands covering the garment, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no cluttered background.

shots.intent: 用翻领、徽章位、螺纹袖口与下摆微距证明做工细节
shots.camera: top-down 90-degree flat lay of the garment with a two-by-two grid of extreme close-up macro insets
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting plus a soft skimming side light revealing rib texture, shallow depth of field in each inset
shots.whitespace: tight crops with minimal leftover whitespace, the details are the subject
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce detail board for {product}, a top-down 90-degree flat lay of the garment with four inset extreme close-up macro crops arranged in a two-by-two grid: the folded lapel collar, the chest emblem area, the ribbed cuff and the ribbed hem. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting plus a soft skimming side light revealing rib texture, shallow depth of field in each inset with the foreground sharp. Background pale sky-blue matte board #E8F4FB. Details fill 55-60% of the frame with tight crops and minimal leftover whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented fabric percentages or test data, no emblem artwork or trademark graphics, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no exaggerated loose threads.

shots.intent: 以晴空主色与空白优惠位收口促单
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view, garment centered, collar facing the camera
shots.lighting: bright punchy studio light with a soft contact shadow
shots.background: sky blue #AEDCF0 with a sunny yellow #F5C542 burst panel behind the garment
shots.props: one empty blank offer-badge frame and one empty blank CTA button shape, both with no text inside
shots.whitespace: balanced margin around the garment, no extra whitespace
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce promo close of {product} centered, straight-on eye-level view with the collar facing the camera, occupying 55-60% of the frame. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background sky blue #AEDCF0 with a sunny yellow #F5C542 burst panel behind the garment, plus one empty blank offer-badge frame and one empty blank CTA button shape, both left with no text inside. Bright punchy studio light with a soft contact shadow. Balanced margin around the garment, no extra whitespace. Negative: no invented discounts, prices or sales numbers, no text inside badges or buttons, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character marks or trademark graphics, no countdown timers.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 晴空蓝活动头图，笔刷大标题配云朵、纸飞机、礼盒涂鸦，底部转入商品信息区；P2 规格区：男童短袖翻领polo衫、2色入、身高段童装尺码（原值已剥离）、面料成分原值（已剥离改占位）、柔软/弹力/厚度/版型四项指示条、蓝色配色展示位；P3 黄色配色展示位，图位多为空白；P4 面料细节区，含舒适手感类描述文案；P5 四宫格细节：小翻领、胸前徽章点缀、螺纹袖口、螺纹下摆。品类判定：尺码为童装身高段量级，且为翻领polo外穿成衣形态，判为母婴/童装而非儿童内衣贴身品类；源图商品图位大量空白，事实以文字区为准。已剥离：原品牌字样与系列名、原平台店铺字样、年份上新与促销角标、成分与尺码原值（一律改占位符）、模特面容、徽章具体图文（仅保留结构位）、英文装饰句与各分区页签原文。
